visual_goal: Show four public cases each testing one book claim, the claims converging on a verdict, and fictional Corvane compared only at the end.
prompt: A left-to-right landscape diagram in three bands. At the left, a vertical stack of four plain unbranded file folders, labeled from top to bottom 'Booking.com', 'Airbnb', 'Expedia and Vrbo', 'Agoda and Trip.com'. In the middle, a vertical stack of four rounded cards, one beside each folder, labeled from top to bottom 'Contract-first connectivity', 'Custody-shaped money', 'Contracts before storefronts', 'Sell from a copy'. One short arrow runs from each folder to the card beside it. To the right, all four cards send one arrow each into a single balance-scale icon labeled 'Verdict'. From the scale, one dashed arrow continues right to a small sketched, clearly imaginary building drawn in light pencil outline labeled 'Corvane, fictional'. Exactly nine arrows.
alt: Four case folders each pointing to the book claim it tests, all claims converging on a verdict scale, and a dashed arrow to a pencil-sketched fictional Corvane compared last.
